text: {"grades": [{"area": "contact", "level": "flag", "reason": "Strangers can message or voice chat with the child by default, and no cited mitigation shows a parent-controlled setting that shuts that door.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_8e13d0d8cf810113", "f_62782efd9b2d6164", "f_bbfb28fb53ef2e38", "f_16520fb8859a88b1"]}, {"area": "money", "level": "flag", "reason": "Multiple reports show children being charged for purchases without receiving items, being scammed, or facing undisclosed recurring charges, with no effective parental control cited to stop these harms.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_4f0d24b3b6bb0948", "f_fe600dad41e0a6a9", "f_a24eb25dc2e2b26a", "f_d34b991c87235fe5"]}, {"area": "data", "level": "flag", "reason": "Reports indicate the app collects personal data for ads or third parties, experiences crashes suggesting data loss, and lacks a cited parent-controlled deletion mechanism.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_6b7cc1eed85a38ff", "f_62ec888b21dd4cc0", "f_e6498b7f3444a749", "f_9aa695a224cc72ec"]}, {"area": "age_gating", "level": "flag", "reason": "First-hand reports show children under the stated age gaining access, and the age gate accepts fake birthdates, with no cited setting locking the account to the correct age band.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_88d325d4c1d10860", "f_cd7875f54b5d560d", "f_6ba7572225c7dd9e", "f_e0fe8d795223c23b"]}, {"area": "content", "level": "ok", "reason": "No cited review reports children actually encountering sexual content, realistic violence, horror, harassment, or self-harm; mentions are vague, disliked features, or about other platforms.", "setting": "", "findings": []}, {"area": "developer_record", "level": "flag", "reason": "Cited reports describe Microsoft (owner of Minecraft) being fined $20 million by the FTC for illegally collecting children's data, which is a regulatory action naming the developer.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_796e7220c1a87086"]}]}
